cohort: Patients between the age range of 20-35 years with a history of previous lower segment caesarean section, having gestational age between 37-41 weeks and who presented in spontaneous labour
finding: Appropriate selection of patients for the trial of VBAC can help reduce the higher rate of repeat caesarean section after a previous caesarean section and increase the chances of successful vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Following a C-section, 28.67% of patients experienced successful vaginal births.
